# OFC Optimizer

> 100% offline Open Face Chinese (OFC) Pineapple Poker solver, Street 0–4 flat-play analyzer, AI full-hand reviewer, and exact Fantasyland optimizer for iOS and Web.

## Core Capabilities (v3.0)
- **Full Street 0–4 Flat-Play Solver**: Evaluates candidate placements by EV, Fantasyland tier probabilities (QQ / KK / AA / Trips), and Foul %.
- **100% Offline iOS Engine**: Zero server latency; works on flights and in live poker rooms. Browser Web App runs quantized neural-net weights locally in a WebWorker.
- **Deck Rules**: Supports both **54-card (2 Jokers)** with legal Joker downgrade rules and **52-card (No Jokers)**.
- **Effective Stack Presets**: 1-tap switching across **50pt, 100pt, 200pt, and ∞ (infinite)** effective stacks with dedicated Fantasyland EV tables.
- **AI Full-Hand Review**: Grades every street (S0–S4) after a battle with Accuracy %, total EV loss, blunder highlights, and instant spot replay.
- **Exact Fantasyland Solver (14–17 cards)**: Branch-and-bound optimal placement with 4×13 suited card keyboard.
- **Free Daily Spot & Curated Pro Drills**: Solver-mined spots across Basic, Standard, and Master tiers plus automatic mistake review.

## Verified Fantasyland EV Benchmarks (Exact Solver + 100,000-Chain Simulation, Own Chains Only)
### 54-Card (2 Jokers) by Effective Stack
- QQ (14 cards): ∞ 23.2pt | 200pt 23.2pt | 100pt 22.8pt | 50pt 20.3pt (-12%)
- KK (15 cards): ∞ 38.0pt | 200pt 37.9pt | 100pt 35.4pt | 50pt 28.0pt (-26%)
- AA (16 cards): ∞ 64.5pt | 200pt 61.9pt | 100pt 51.3pt | 50pt 35.5pt (-45%)
- Trips (17 cards): ∞ 126.4pt | 200pt 100.7pt | 100pt 69.8pt | 50pt 42.0pt (-67%)

### 52-Card (No Jokers, ∞ Stack)
- QQ (14 cards): 14.0pt (-40%, 11.5% repeat rate)
- KK (15 cards): 21.1pt (-44%, 19.9% repeat rate)
- AA (16 cards): 33.0pt (-49%, 35.0% repeat rate)
- Trips (17 cards): 58.5pt (-54%, 55.6% repeat rate)
